intro.description: Specialized in web development, I love creating innovative solutions both in front-end and back-end. Always looking for new challenges that allow me to grow professionally.

paragraph.second: I hold a Software Engineering degree from the
paragraph.secondAfter: and currently work as a software developer specializing in web and mobile applications.
paragraph.third: Throughout my career, I have contributed to projects using technologies such as React, React Native, Vue, Ionic, and .NET, building solutions focused on user experience, Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) connectivity, and AI-powered conversational systems.
paragraph.fourth: I consider myself a proactive and adaptable professional who enjoys solving complex problems and continuously expanding both technical and professional skills.
paragraph.fifth: In my free time, I enjoy exploring new technologies, practicing sports, and spending time with friends.

cta.paragraph: If you have an idea, a project or just want to connect, I'll be happy to hear from you.
